what_this_is: One record per repo across envbench_python100 (100), rat_python50 (50) and rat_python50_new (50): the final test count -- CERTIFIED (gold, from gold_manifests_combined.json) or PARTIAL (best recorded attempt, a lower bound, from the *_partial.json files) -- plus the step-by-step trace of the agent session that produced that exact result, parsed from its agent-transcript.jsonl.
caveats: Steps are for the WINNING session only. For best-of-N runs the other attempts' transcripts were not kept.
Inputs/results/notes are truncated (see '[+N chars]'); the full transcript is at artifacts_dir.

summary.turns = tool_calls + 1 for EVERY agent (a model turn per tool call plus the final answer). This matches Claude Code's own num_turns exactly in 174/182 sessions; codex reports no turn count. Claude's own value is kept as turns_reported (it undercounts sessions interrupted by a usage limit or restart). cost_usd / duration_min are Claude-only; codex records carry tokens_used.

verify_runs = tool calls that executed ./verify; verify_results = distinct ./verify result objects the agent saw (from any tool output or notification -- agents often ran verify in the background and read it later; a re-read of the same result counts once). verify_trajectory = `collected` of each result in order; first_accepted_at_verify = index of the first accepted:true result.
dockerfile_writes: for Claude, Write/Edit/shell writes to Dockerfile; for codex, distinct Dockerfile states in its printed diffs.
summary.started_from: 'seed' = the session began from the harness's minimal seed Dockerfile; 'inherited' = it continued an earlier session's Dockerfile, so its steps show only the finishing work.
provenance_gap marks records whose saved transcript cannot explain the result; session_cut_short marks sessions that hit a usage limit mid-run but whose steps are still the complete record.

A session can end (timeout, usage limit, or the agent stopping) before it sees accepted:true itself; the harness certifies the Dockerfile left behind AFTER the session, and that certificate is what counts -- so first_accepted_at_verify can be null on a CERTIFIED record.
node_ids are NOT repeated here; they live in gold_manifests_combined.json and the *_partial.json files.
